content_of_post_to_comment: I admit this is a very different video than my normal videos, but I felt compelled because our divided country is not a healthy one. So, I will do anything I can do to help us get back on a healthy track. What do you think? Do you agree with the summary and my take? Disagree? Please share  in the comments.
comment: Trying to bring people back to a healthier conversation is a worthwhile goal, but I think it also depends on being willing to examine why people feel divided in the first place. Sometimes the same facts are interpreted through very different experiences and fears. I'm curious whether your video focuses more on finding common ground or on changing minds, because those require very different approaches.
